newsitem.title: FRANCE: FORECAST - CDC bank cuts French growth projections.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - CDC bank cuts French growth projections.

text.p: French state bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) said on Monday it had cuts its forecast for French economic growth in the third and fourth quarters to 0.6 and 0.3 percent from 0.7 and 0.5 percent respectively.
The bank said this was because of "a deterioration in the factors underlying greater optimism last month", citing in particular a 5.6 percent drop in consumer spending in September.
The bank said it was counting on 0.4 percent growth in the first quarter of 1997.
